html:
Qatar is a small peninsula on the western shore of the Persian Gulf, ruled since the 1800s by the Al Thani family. On the 1880 and 1900 maps it is a sheikhdom living on pearl diving and fishing.

Before the 1860s Qatar's towns were often under the sway of Bahrain's rulers. After a war between them, Britain signed an agreement in 1868 with Mohammed bin Thani, which marked Qatar out as a separate place. In 1871 the Ottoman Empire placed a garrison in Doha. Jassim bin Mohammed Al Thani played Ottomans and British against each other, and in 1893 his men beat an Ottoman force at the Battle of Al Wajbah.

The Ottomans left during the First World War, and in 1916 Qatar became a British protectorate. Oil was found in 1939. Qatar became independent in 1971, and its gas wealth later funded the Qatar Investment Authority.
sum: Qatar is a small peninsula on the western shore of the Persian Gulf, ruled since the 1800s by the Al Thani family. On the 1880 and 1900 maps it is a sheikhdom living on pearl diving and fishing.
